column1: # Hand-kept statuses for tools/tu_coverage.py (win over the automatic ones). Columns tab-separated.
# Function rows: status ported / partial / explained / irrelevant / open, or empty = keep the automatic status and only
#   add the note; tu_addr = any address inside the TU function; pc = PC partner from a finding (beats the map);
#   retail = retail partner from a finding / plugin (tu_addr must then be the TU function start; beats the alignment).
#   ported / explained / irrelevant here also close every open block of the function (a hand check of the whole body).
# Block rows: status covered (a plugin translates this changed block, evidence in the note), noport (the block needs
#   no port, reason in the note) or uncovered (a plugin names it, but does not translate it); tu_addr = any address
